seoTitle: Divine Souls By Priya — Healing, tarot, and Vedic sittings in Dehradun
description: Priya holds healing sittings, tarot readings, and Vedic work in Dehradun. Fifteen years in practice. Write or WhatsApp to begin.

hero.headline:
When something will not settle,
come sit with Priya.
hero.subhead: Healing, tarot, and Vedic work — in Dehradun, or by message if you cannot travel.

statement.line1: Come with the thing that keeps you up.

stories.title: A sitting for the person in the chair.

compare.title: Candle work. Then the sitting.

items.title: One person, one sitting
items.body: She works with whoever is in front of her. No two hours look the same.

items.title: Years in the craft
items.body: Lama Fera Grandmaster, High Priestess of ITW, and a meditation teacher. Fifteen years, not a weekend course.

items.title: The whole of you
items.body: Healing, cards, and ritual can sit in one hour. You do not need three appointments.

items.title: A reading you can use
items.body: Tarot that names what is already true, then points to the next honest step.

items.title: Work you take home
items.body: Vedic practice and charged tools, so the sitting does not end at the door.

items.title: When one hour is not enough
items.body: Courses, kits, and another conversation if the work needs more time.

spotlight.title:
Magic has no colour.
Intention does.
spotlight.body: Priya does not split this work into black or white. What you bring, and why you bring it, is what shapes the hour.

items.title: Tell her what is going on
items.body: A question, a season, or something you cannot name yet. That is enough.

items.title: She will say what fits
items.body: A healing sitting, a reading, a course, or a tool charged for your situation.

items.title: You sit
items.body: In Dehradun, or from where you are. Call, write, or send a WhatsApp.

faq.title: Things people ask first
faq.intro: The practical bits. The rest can wait until you speak.

items.q: Do I have to know which sitting I want?
items.a: No. Tell Priya what is going on. She will say whether it is a healing, a reading, a course, or something to take home.

items.q: Can she work with me if I am not in Dehradun?
items.a: Yes. The room is in Dehradun, and a lot of the work can be held at a distance. Say which you need when you write.
A few lines is enough. WhatsApp +91 7668648224, email priyasinha1809@gmail.com, or use the contact page. Leave your name, a number, and what you want to work on.
It depends on the work. Priya will tell you before you sit, so you are not guessing.

items.q: Is this a religion I have to join?
items.a: No. People come with a problem, a question, or a stretch of life that will not settle. You leave with the next step. You do not have to take on a faith.

closing.title:
When you are ready,
write.
closing.body: Priya is in Dehradun. The first note can come from anywhere.
